ContentRef.description:
Where a large or sensitive body lives: `event_content.hash` (xxh3-128
hex) and its length. Retention may delete the body; the ref stays.

size.description: The whole body's length, stored or not.

truncated.description: Only the first part was stored (bodies are capped).

SubagentRef.description:
A subagent inside an agent session, as a tool event or a subagent
event names it: not a session of its own, but who in the session acted.

id.description:
The harness's id for the subagent, or the id of the call that
started it when the harness gives none.

kind.description: What kind of subagent the harness says it is, when it says.

ToolKind.description: What a tool call does, as oxplow reads it.

oneOf.description: Writes, edits, deletes or moves files — the call names them.
Starts a subagent, which runs tools of its own.
Asks the person a question and waits for the answer.
Puts a plan to the person and waits for approval.
Anything else (a to-do list, a mode switch, thinking).

description:
`agent.tool.finished@3`: a tool call returned (PostToolUse). As
`agent.tool.finished@2`, plus the subagent that made the call, when it
wasn't the session's own agent. v2 upcasts as is (no subagent).

command.description: A shell call's command line, whole.

ok.description: Whether it succeeded, when the harness said.

subagent.description:
The subagent that made the call, when it wasn't the session's own
agent.

title: AgentToolFinishedV3
